prompts.question: Does this company have a verifiable 2GIS listing showing its offices, retail or warehouse locations, opening hours and direct phone numbers?
prompts.why_it_matters: A mapped card with photos and reviews shows the company has a real physical presence and reachable contacts.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the 2GIS search box for the relevant city and open the matching organisation card.
prompts.found_when: A card under the company's name exists with an address, hours or phone and matches the company being checked.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no card for the company name in its stated city or region.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The name is too common to isolate, several unrelated brands share it, or the map page will not load.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Agroinvestor's company A-Z directory or in its agribusiness rankings and coverage?
prompts.why_it_matters: Presence in this trade press indicates the company is a recognised player in Russian agribusiness and food production.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan the Agroinvestor company A-Z list and site search for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company has its own profile entry or is named in a ranking or article on the site.
prompts.not_found_when: The A-Z list and site search return nothing for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The list cannot be browsed, the site search fails, or the name matches many unrelated farms.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member in the ARPP 'Domestic Software' member directory or software catalog?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership is an industry credential often quoted in claims of being a domestic software producer.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the ARPP member directory search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member card or catalog entry for the company exists in the directory.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no member card or catalog entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search is unavailable, or the name returns too many similar software firms to confirm a match.

prompts.question: Does Seldon Basis hold a company record showing credit risk, insolvency signals, arbitration disputes or procurement activity for this company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Risk indexes and litigation records reveal financial and legal exposure a counterparty should know about.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Seldon Basis search and enter the full legal name or INN of the company.
prompts.found_when: A company profile opens with risk index, court or procurement data attached to the entity.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no matching legal entity for the name or INN.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup requires a paid account, the name returns multiple similar entities, or the page is unreadable.

prompts.question: Has this company filed annual statutory financial statements in the GIR BO accounting statements resource?
prompts.why_it_matters: Filing shows the entity reports officially and lets claimed revenue or size be checked against filed figures.

source.name: State Information Resource of Accounting (Financial) Statements (GIR BO)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the GIR BO organisation search by the company's name or INN and open its statements page.
prompts.found_when: An organisation record exists with at least one year of filed balance sheet or profit and loss data.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search finds no organisation record for the name or INN.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search service is down, the name is ambiguous, or the entity is exempt from filing and cannot be confirmed either way.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Bank of Russia registers of financial market participants, or on the CBR Warning List of entities with signs of illegal financial activity?
prompts.why_it_matters: A licence entry confirms the company may legally offer financial services and a warning entry is a serious red flag.

source.name: Bank of Russia (CBR) - Registers of Financial Market Participants

prompts.how_to_query: Scan the relevant CBR register list and the Warning List for the company's full legal name.
prompts.found_when: The company is named in a CBR register, or named on the Warning List, in the current published list.
prompts.not_found_when: The name appears in neither the registers nor the Warning List after checking the relevant lists.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lists cannot be opened, the entity type is unclear so the right register is unknown, or the name is too generic to match.

prompts.question: Has CNews published articles, rankings or contract reports naming this company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Coverage in this IT business portal shows how visible the company is and what claims the press has made about it.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the CNews site search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: Search results list at least one article, ranking or contract report naming the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no article mentioning the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page fails, or the company name is a common word producing results that cannot be attributed.

prompts.question: Is this company or its leadership listed on Delovaya Rossiya's published list of members and persons?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership links the company to a national business association and its advocacy activity.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan the Delovaya Rossiya persons and members pages for the company name and its executives.
prompts.found_when: A person or company page names this company as the organisation represented in Delovaya Rossiya.
prompts.not_found_when: Scanning the published lists finds neither the company nor a named executive tied to it.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The list is only partly published, cannot be searched, or the person name is too common to attribute.

prompts.question: Does this company have an employer profile with ratings and employee reviews on DreamJob?
prompts.why_it_matters: Employer ratings reveal how staff rate management, pay fairness and working conditions.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the DreamJob company search and open the matching employer page.
prompts.found_when: An employer page exists for the company with a rating or at least one published review.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no employer page for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search cannot be run, the name matches several employers, or review content is behind a login.

prompts.question: Is this company registered in the FNS EGRUL/EGRIP registry, and does its official extract show active status, matching name, INN, OGRN and legal address?
prompts.why_it_matters: The official register extract is the baseline proof that the entity legally exists and that its stated details match.

source.name: Federal Tax Service (FNS) - EGRUL / EGRIP Registry

prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company's name or OGRN/INN in the EGRUL search and download the generated extract.
prompts.found_when: An extract is issued for the entity and its name, INN, OGRN, address and status are readable.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search by name and INN returns no matching record in the register.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The service is unavailable, the captcha blocks the query, or the name returns many similar entities so the extract cannot be tied to the company.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Fedresurs with published legally significant facts such as pledges, reorganisations, capital reductions or bankruptcy notices?
prompts.why_it_matters: Mandatory disclosure events expose asset pledges, restructuring and insolvency risk that are not advertised on company websites.

source.name: Fedresurs - Unified Federal Register of Legally Significant Facts

prompts.how_to_query: Search Fedresurs by the company's name or OGRN/INN and open the entity's published messages.
prompts.found_when: The entity page lists at least one published message of a legally significant fact.
prompts.not_found_when: The entity is found but has no published messages, or no entity record matches the search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search requires a login or captcha that blocks access, or the name is too common to match a single entity.

prompts.question: Does Kontur.Focus hold a counterparty dossier for this company with risk signals, ownership chain, sanctions status or customs activity?
prompts.why_it_matters: Aggregated risk signals and beneficial owner tracing expose counterparty exposure that is hard to see elsewhere.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name or INN in the Kontur.Focus search and open the resulting dossier.
prompts.found_when: A dossier opens for the entity showing risk indicators, owners or activity data.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no entity matching the name or INN.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Full data requires a paid subscription, the name returns many similar entities, or the page cannot be read.

prompts.question: Is this company registered in the Rosselkhoznadzor FSIS Vetrf / Cerberus registry of enterprises certified for animal product handling?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only registered enterprises may legally process, store or transport animal products, so presence or absence is decisive for that activity.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Cerberus public certified-enterprise list by the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears as a certified enterprise with a registry record.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search by company name returns no certified enterprise record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The registry search is down or requires credentials, or the company does not operate in this sector so the registry does not apply.

prompts.question: Does this company have a corporate blog or a substantial body of articles and comments about it on Habr?
prompts.why_it_matters: Habr shows technical reputation and staff experience that engineers check before joining or buying.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Habr companies and articles for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A company profile, corporate blog or several articles naming the company are found.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no company profile and no article about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search cannot be completed or the name is a generic term returning unrelated technical posts.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the NOSTROY unified register of SRO members with active construction membership and a valid contract price limit?
prompts.why_it_matters: Construction work in Russia requires SRO membership, so a missing or suspended entry means the company cannot legally take such contracts.

source.name: National Association of Builders (NOSTROY) - Unified Register of SRO Members

prompts.how_to_query: Search the NOSTROY SRO member register by the company's name or OGRN/INN.
prompts.found_when: A member record exists showing active membership and a permitted contract price limit.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no member record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is unavailable, or the company is not a construction firm so the register does not apply.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in OPORA Russia's published list of members?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership signals the company is an accepted SME-sector participant with access to the association's support network.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan OPORA Russia's published member list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company name appears in the published member list.
prompts.not_found_when: Scanning the member list finds no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The list is incomplete or unreadable, or the name is too generic to identify the right member.

prompts.question: Does this company have employee reviews on Pravda Sotrudnikov alleging problems such as salary delays, shadow accounting or management misconduct?
prompts.why_it_matters: Anonymous staff accounts can surface labour and pay problems the company would not disclose.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the Pravda Sotrudnikov search and open the company's review page.
prompts.found_when: A company page exists with at least one review attributed to the employer.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no company page or no reviews for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site is unreachable, or the name matches several employers so reviews cannot be attributed.

prompts.question: Has RB.ru (Rusbase) published company data or articles naming this company, such as investment deals or founder coverage?
prompts.why_it_matters: Coverage here documents funding, founders and partnerships that support or undercut the company's own story.
prompts.how_to_query: Search RB.ru for the company name and open any matching company profile or article.
prompts.found_when: A company record or article naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no company record and no article about it.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search cannot be run or the name returns unrelated results.

prompts.question: Does Retail.ru host a company page or articles naming this company in retail, FMCG or supply chain coverage?
prompts.why_it_matters: Trade coverage shows whether the company is a recognised supplier or retail partner in its market.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Retail.ru by the company name and open any company card or article.
prompts.found_when: A company page or an article naming the company is found.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no company page and no article mentioning it.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search fails or the name returns unrelated retail vocabulary matches.

prompts.question: Does this company hold state registration certificates or sanitary-epidemiological conclusions listed in Rospotrebnadzor's registers?
prompts.why_it_matters: Consumer-protection registration is a legal prerequisite for many products and shows compliance history.

source.name: Rospotrebnadzor - Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection

prompts.how_to_query: Search the Rospotrebnadzor register pages by the company name or OGRN/INN.
prompts.found_when: At least one certificate or conclusion is registered to the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search by name and INN returns no registration record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is unavailable, or the company's products fall outside these registers so nothing can be concluded.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in RSPP's published registries of members?
prompts.why_it_matters: RSPP membership indicates the company is recognised among major Russian industrial enterprises.

source.name: Russian Union of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs (RSPP)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the RSPP registries page and search the member lists for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company name appears in an RSPP member registry.
prompts.not_found_when: The registries contain no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The registry files cannot be opened or searched, or the name matches several similar entities.

prompts.question: Does Rusprofile hold a dossier for this company showing its reliability rating, revenue history, court cases, government contracts and affiliates?
prompts.why_it_matters: A consolidated dossier lets claimed size, history and good standing be tested against official data.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name or INN in the Rusprofile search and open the matching entity page.
prompts.found_when: A dossier page opens for the entity with financial, court or contract data.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no entity matching the name or INN.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site blocks automated queries, the name returns many similar entities, or full data needs a paid plan.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in RUSSOFT's member directory of Russian software development and engineering companies?
prompts.why_it_matters: RUSSOFT membership supports claims of software engineering capability and export experience.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan the RUSSOFT members page for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member profile for the company appears in the directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The member directory contains no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The members page cannot be loaded or filtered, or the name matches several IT firms.

prompts.question: Does this company run a corporate channel or have notable video content on Rutube?
prompts.why_it_matters: A corporate video presence shows the company publishes its own material on Russian platforms and is visible to domestic audiences.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Rutube by the company name and check for an official channel or videos about it.
prompts.found_when: An official-looking corporate channel or several videos clearly about the company are found.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no channel and no video about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search fails, or results are dominated by unrelated videos using the same words.

prompts.question: Has this company or its founders published material or been covered on Spark.ru?
prompts.why_it_matters: Spark.ru posts show how the company presents its product and funding story to the startup community.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the Spark.ru search and review matching posts and profiles.
prompts.found_when: At least one post or profile about the company is found.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns nothing about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is unavailable or the name returns unrelated posts.

prompts.question: Does this company have a product page with user ratings or reviews on Sravni.ru?
prompts.why_it_matters: Verified customer feedback shows how the company's financial or insurance products are actually rated.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Sravni.ru for the company name and open any matching product or provider page.
prompts.found_when: A provider or product page for the company exists with reviews or a rating.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no page carrying the company's reviews.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company offers no comparable product on the site, or the search cannot be completed.

prompts.question: Do court decisions naming this company appear in the SudAct database?
prompts.why_it_matters: Published judgments reveal lawsuits, consumer claims and labour or administrative penalties against the company and its executives.

source.name: SudAct - Judicial and Regulatory Acts of the Russian Federation

prompts.how_to_query: Run a full-text search on SudAct for the company's name and review the decisions listed.
prompts.found_when: Search results list decisions in which the company is a named party.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean full-text search returns no decisions naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page fails, or the name is too common to tell which decisions concern this company.

prompts.question: Does TAdviser hold a corporate profile for this company with IT projects, state contracts, revenue rankings or management biographies?
prompts.why_it_matters: The profile lets claimed IT projects, customers and revenue be compared with a documented record.
prompts.how_to_query: Search TAdviser by the company name and open the matching company article.
prompts.found_when: A company article exists with profile data, projects or contracts.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no company article.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The wiki search times out or the name matches several IT entities.

prompts.question: Has this company posted vacancies on TrudVsem, the state Work in Russia portal?
prompts.why_it_matters: Statutory vacancy postings confirm the company actively operates and hires in the regions it names.
prompts.how_to_query: Search TrudVsem vacancies by the company name and open its employer page.
prompts.found_when: Vacancies or an employer record for the company are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no vacancy and no employer record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The portal or open-data API is unavailable, or the name is too generic to isolate the employer.

prompts.question: Does VC.ru carry company-authored posts about this company or user posts complaining about it?
prompts.why_it_matters: VC.ru mixes self-published company material with customer complaints, so it shows both the company's story and disputes.
prompts.how_to_query: Search VC.ru by the company name and review matching articles and complaint posts.
prompts.found_when: At least one post about the company or authored by it is found.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no post about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search API is unavailable or the name returns many unrelated posts.

prompts.question: Does Vedomosti have a company page or articles about this company's results, ownership or corporate conflicts?
prompts.why_it_matters: Reporting in a leading business daily is an independent record of financial performance and corporate disputes.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Vedomosti for the company name and open its company page or relevant articles.
prompts.found_when: A company page or at least one article about the company is found.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no company page and no article naming it.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Articles are behind a paywall or the name returns unrelated results.

prompts.question: Does this company have a verified organisation card on Yandex Maps with addresses, hours, ratings and customer reviews?
prompts.why_it_matters: The card confirms a real branch footprint and shows what customers publicly say about the locations.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in Yandex Maps search and open the matching organisation card.
prompts.found_when: An organisation card exists with an address and either a rating or reviews.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no organisation card for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The name matches many unrelated organisations, or the map search cannot be loaded.

prompts.question: Does this company have an employer profile with open vacancies on Zarplata.ru?
prompts.why_it_matters: A regional employer profile confirms hiring activity and a local presence in the regions it claims to serve.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Zarplata.ru employers and vacancies by the company name.
prompts.found_when: An employer profile or vacancies for the company are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no employer profile and no vacancies.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search is unavailable or the name is too generic to isolate the employer.
